question: Within a frozen finite carrier/reconstruction model, does an explicit witness-custody mode separate structural obligations that are ambiguous when the mode is projected away?
quantifiers: Exhaust all 3 * 2^10 * 2^5 = 98,304 frozen records. Compare equivalence classes after projecting mode away with classes retaining mode. Then reuse the same relation on one fresh three-field TransportCertificate instance.
arithmetic_domain: Rational is opaque. No additive-zero, multiplicative-unit, quotient, inverse, commutation, or M6 calculation is performed. Noncommutative order is only a preserved Boolean obligation.

candidate_grammar.carried: all declared fields are present; reconstruction recipe/input members are absent
candidate_grammar.reconstructed: carried fields are absent; pinned recipe and reconstruction inputs are present
candidate_grammar.omitted: the document does not say which obligation family applies

evaluation.success: the mode-free projection has at least one mixed-status equivalence class, retaining mode has none, all declared refusal controls pass, and the relation reuses on the fresh instance
evaluation.refusal: request pin, checker pin, noncommutative order, or exclusive custody shape fails
evaluation.unknown: mode is omitted or native reconstruction is structurally prepared but not executed
evaluation.claim_boundary: structural discrimination only; no native adapter, semantic certificate acceptance, universality, trust, or word promotion
